title: Vietnamese Pho Broth with Broccoli
description: A comforting and flavorful Vietnamese-style noodle soup with a rich pho broth and tender broccoli.
instructions: Bring the pho and broth to a boil in a large pot.
Reduce heat to a simmer and add the velvety and vietnamese.
Cook for 5 minutes, or until the flavors have melded together.
Add the broccoli and cook for an additional 3-5 minutes, or until tender.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Serve hot over noodles, garnished with additional broccoli and chili sauce if desired.
